QuestInfo.name: A Clue to the Secret Book
QuestInfo.0: I hear #b#p608##k in #m10005000# is going through hard times... I should go check on him.
QuestInfo.1: I met an old, balding man named #b#p608##k in the VIP Sauna in #m10005000#. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. \r\n#b#p608##k told me that his son, #b#p320##k, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around #m10002000#. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...???
QuestInfo.2: I found #b#p320##k in the tree tunnel of #m10002000#, as requested by #p608#, whom I met at the #m10005003#.

0.0: Good job getting here. Actually, I have a favor to ask you. If you accept it, I'll give you a piece of clothing that you'll need in return. I think you are more than capable of doing it. Even if you don't care, please just listen to my story first.
0.1: I have a son that can do no wrong. But one day he took a book of mine that is very dear to me and left. That book... hmmm... I can't tell you the details, but it is a very, very important book to me...
0.2: If you get me that book back safely, I'll give you a comfortable article of clothing, perfect for saunas like this. What do you think? Will you find my son and take back that book?

yes.0: Ohhh... Thank you so much. It won't be easy locating my son on this humongous Victoria Island. I'm guessing that he may be in a passage made of trees near the forest at #m10002000#, because that's his favorite spot... Best of luck to you!

no.0: I see... I guess you're busy with things here and there... but I'd definitely reward you handsomely for your work. So if you ever change your mind, please let me know.

1.0: Hey, who are you? You know my dad well?

npc.0: You haven't found my son yet, huh? He took a very important book with him. I'll definitely reward you handsomely for your work. He may be in a passage made of trees, in the forest near #m10002000#.
